significance: One of the three principal shrines in India to the tantric goddess Bagalamukhi, at Bankhandi in Kangra district, where the image sits on a golden throne among jewelled pillars. Worship here is sought for power over adversaries and the temple fills at Navratri.
story: Rama, guided by Hanuman, is said to have worshipped Bagalamukhi at this spot before his war with Ravana and to have been granted the Brahmastra; a fire pit in the temple is pointed out as the place of his rite.
